verbs.label: Read
verbs.definition: Retrieve the current value of a resource without modifying it.

verbs.label: List
verbs.definition: Enumerate the members of a collection without modifying any.

verbs.label: Count
verbs.definition: Return the cardinality of a collection without modifying it.

verbs.label: Search
verbs.definition: Query a corpus for matching entries and return references, without modifying the corpus.

verbs.label: Measure
verbs.definition: Take a quantitative observation of a state; the observation itself does not change the state.

verbs.label: Create
verbs.definition: Bring a new entity into existence. The inverse is delete of that entity.

verbs.label: Update
verbs.definition: Modify the value or attributes of an existing entity in place. The inverse is restore from the pre-image.

verbs.label: Append
verbs.definition: Extend a sequence or log with a new entry, without altering existing entries. Inverse is truncation of the appended entry.

verbs.label: Delete
verbs.definition: Remove an existing entity. Reversibility depends on whether a pre-image was retained; the verb itself does not assert one.

verbs.label: Move
verbs.definition: Change the location or ownership of an entity without altering its content. Inverse is a move back to the origin.

verbs.label: Copy
verbs.definition: Produce a new entity whose content mirrors an existing one, without modifying the source.

verbs.label: Open
verbs.definition: Bring an entity into an interactive or accessible state — a UI window, a stream, a session. Inverse is close.

verbs.label: Close
verbs.definition: Take an entity out of its interactive/accessible state. The observable content persists; the accessibility does not.

verbs.label: Schedule
verbs.definition: Register an action to occur at a specified moment. Inverse is cancellation before the moment arrives.

verbs.label: Cancel
verbs.definition: Withdraw a scheduled action before it takes effect. If the action has already executed, cancel is not admissible.

verbs.label: Send
verbs.definition: Communicate a payload from a sender to a receiver via a channel. Instance of TriadicAction: the message mediates sender and receiver.

verbs.label: Publish
verbs.definition: Make content available to a channel or audience. TriadicAction — the channel mediates author and audience.

verbs.label: Subscribe
verbs.definition: Register interest in future messages on a channel. Inverse is unsubscribe.

verbs.label: Invite
verbs.definition: Propose participation to a party in a scheduled interaction. Reversibility limited: invites are receivable and cannot be recalled from cognition even when withdrawn.

verbs.label: Share
verbs.definition: Extend access to a resource from an owner to another party. Inverse is unshare — resource state is preserved.

verbs.label: Acknowledge
verbs.definition: Confirm receipt of a message. Distinct from acting on the message — the reply reports observation, not effect.

verbs.label: Sign
verbs.definition: Produce a cryptographic attestation binding a party to a payload. The attestation is verifiable; it cannot be unmade after issuance.

verbs.label: Encrypt
verbs.definition: Transform content into a form only holders of a key can read. Inverse is decrypt with the paired key.

verbs.label: Decrypt
verbs.definition: Recover plaintext from ciphertext using the paired key. The observation is one-way — once seen, a payload cannot be unseen.

verbs.label: Enable
verbs.definition: Grant a capability to a subject. Inverse is disable.

verbs.label: Deny
verbs.definition: Refuse a capability request. The refusal is a decision receipt; the capability remains unavailable until re-authorised.

verbs.label: Approve
verbs.definition: Adjudicate a proposal as admissible. The approval is a decision-of-record; the underlying proposal may still be withdrawn.

verbs.label: Reject
verbs.definition: Adjudicate a proposal as inadmissible. Distinct from deny: reject applies to a proposal in review, deny to a capability request.

verbs.label: Revoke
verbs.definition: Withdraw a previously granted capability or credential. The historical grant persists in the audit; future authority does not.

verbs.label: Learn
verbs.definition: Acquire, modify, or reinforce knowledge from observed evidence.

verbs.label: Reason
verbs.definition: Derive a conclusion from premises via a specified inference method.

verbs.label: Abstain
verbs.definition: Decline to produce an answer when evidence is insufficient. Distinct from failure — a considered non-answer is a decision.

verbs.label: Remember
verbs.definition: Persist a fact to durable memory so it survives the current session. Inverse is forget.

verbs.label: Forget
verbs.definition: Remove a previously remembered fact. If the fact was replicated elsewhere the observation cannot itself be unmade.

verbs.label: Execute
verbs.definition: Run a specified computation to completion. Reversibility depends on the computation; the verb itself asserts none.
